item.title: Undertone 1.34.1
item.description:
• In a standup, when the host just calls your name (even misheard), the hints panel now brings up a card for your update: what you did, what's next and blockers, from what Undertone knows of your work.
  • Someone else asking whether it's their turn no longer shows you an answer card, and answer cards no longer mistake other people's updates for your work.

Undertone 1.34.0

  • New on Home: Deadlines. Launches, milestones and dates promised to customers, picked up from what's said in your meetings.
  • Your last month of meetings is read once so deadlines show up right away.

Undertone 1.33.8

  • Work calendar events show again if an earlier Google Calendar check came back empty.

Undertone 1.33.7

  • Up next no longer loses meetings when a Google Calendar check comes back incomplete.

Undertone 1.33.6

  • Security: workspace rules only use the tools their action needs, never search, history, edits or deletes
  • Security: canvases can't reach the network, including exported copies
  • Security: single sign-on needs the company to verify its domain with a DNS record (shown in Settings)
  • Calendar Join buttons only open real Zoom, Meet, Teams and Webex links
  • Usage count and usage stats now start off; turn them on in setup or Settings if you'd like to help
  • Fixed a crash when connecting some tools that sign in through the browser
